picks.headline: Google AI Mode now integrates with Canva, YouTube Music and Instacart
picks.rationale: Fresh, credible product news: conversational AI playlist curation lands in a mainstream platform, distinct from the earlier Spotify/TIDAL cards.
picks.excerpt: Google's AI Mode in Search now hooks into YouTube Music, letting users generate and shape playlists conversationally from a prompt, alongside a Canva design integration. It pushes AI-driven, chat-based curation deeper into how listeners assemble music.

picks.headline: Almudio releases 3D Panner, a FREE binaural spatial audio plugin
picks.rationale: Highly actionable free tool producers can grab today, plus a candid window into the AI-assisted plugin-development debate.
picks.excerpt: A free early-access binaural/HRTF panner for headphone mixing, ASMR, game audio and VR. The developer is candid about using AI during the coding process while insisting the DSP, HRTF and UX decisions were his own — a window into the ongoing craft debate over AI-assisted audio-plugin development.

picks.headline: BBC's music boss Lorna Clarke outlines broadcaster's AI transparency commitments — but can it actually meet them?
picks.rationale: Signals a concrete disclosure expectation from a major broadcaster that directly affects how creators submit AI-assisted work.
picks.excerpt: The BBC will keep prioritising music that is 'the result of meaningful human creativity' while allowing AI-assisted work — but wants artists and labels to disclose how AI tools were used when submitting music. It signals how AI-in-the-workflow is becoming a labelling/disclosure expectation for creators, not just a licensing fight.
